claims.text: This event revealed to markets that the thesis regarding frontier-AI capital expenditure and Nvidia's demand being moated by compute scale was incorrect, as an open-weights frontier-class reasoning model had been achieved at significantly lower costs than incumbent standards [Source: ev-1].

Specifically, DeepSeek-R1 was released on January 20, 2025 [Source: ev-1], following its predecessor DeepSeek-V3 (released December 26, 2024), which reported training on roughly 2.79 million GPU-hours at a claimed cost of about US$5.6 million using export-restricted H800 chips [Source: ev-1].
